messages:
maria: Heads-up: We plan to enable FIPS-mode keystore validation cluster-wide this Thur 22:00 UTC. This changes TLS cipher negotiation and strict cert validation for KMS endpoints. Expect some GPU node boot failures if nodes still talk to legacy keystore endpoints or use old IAM boundary assumptions.

aj: How big is the blast radius? which regions first?

maria: Priority rollout order: staging -> eu-west-1 canary -> us-west-2 -> rest. Blast radius limited to onboarding/warmpool flows; existing active requests should be unaffected. Still, provisioning could fail (DecryptError) and stall GPU warmups.

devin: Proposed mitigations: pre-warm extra reserved capacity in canary, add temporary fallback keystore variant (non-FIPS) behind a routing flag, and bump audit sampling to 100% for decrypt ops during canary window so we can correlate failures.

selena: Cost question: pre-warm + 100% sampling — rough estimate?

devin: rough math — reserve one extra 8xA100 pool in eu-west-1 for 6h = ~0.8% monthly cost bump for prod; sampling adds ~0.1% to logging egress during window. I'll put numbers in the playbook.

maria: Adding runbook items. Key checks: 1) keystore TLS certs validated by new CA hash 2) IAM role boundary must contain kms:Decrypt for node bootstrap role. 3) egress firewall allowlist to new KMS IPs.

aj: Can we get a small terraform snippet to validate the IAM boundary?

maria: paste: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_policy" "node_keystore_bootstrap" {
  name = "node-keystore-bootstrap"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Action = ["kms:Decrypt"],
      Effect = "Allow",
      Resource = "*",
      Condition = {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "ec2.${var.region}.amazonaws.com"}}
    }]
  })
}
```

devin: Also adding a firewall short-term rule: allow outbound TCP 443 to the KMS egress IP set + health-check to keystore port. Example nftables block: ```bash
# allow KMS egress for canary
add rule inet filter output ip daddr {52.95.0.0/16, 3.5.0.0/16} tcp dport 443 accept
```

ops-bot: [automated scan] Found 12 nodes in eu-west-1 still using legacy-keystore-v1 cert thumbprint; flagged for replacement.

selena: Ok, timeline + owners? Need to check compliance sign-off for FIPS key usage.

maria: Timeline: Wed 18:00 run pre-check script (aj), Wed 20:00 swap canary routing to fips-keystore (devin), Thu 22:00 enable cluster-wide. Owners: pre-check = aj, firewall + routing = devin, metrics + sampling = selena, rollback plan = maria.

aj: I'll run pre-check and push results to #eng-security-canaries.

devin: I'll stage the fallback routing flag and confirm warm-pool scale-up works with the new keystore.

selena: I'll add cost estimates and get compliance ack; also wiring up alert queries: keystore_decrypt_fail_rate > 0.5% for 5m and gpu_onboard_lag_ms p95 > 30s.

maria: If those alerts fire during canary, automatic rollback to legacy routing and scale-down will trigger per runbook.

aj: one more ask — canary region needs extra log retention (30d) for audit. I can enable temporary retention policy.

devin: ack. I'll also add a short test harness to simulate node bootstrap decrypt errors so we can rehearse rollback.

selena: all good from me. Please post final playbook link when ready.

maria: Will do. TL;DR — FIPS keystore rollout Thu; eu-west-1 canary; warm pool + fallback; watch decrypt failures + gpu warmup latency; owners assigned. :thumbsup:
